title: A release checklist with progress steps (no store)
prompt: Build a small release checklist with three items: "Write the release notes" (25% done), "Run the full test suite" (0% done) and "Tag the release" (already done). Each shows a progress indicator with steps. No store is needed; use the todo item component's own attributes. Put the content inside <main id="outlet">. No script.

assert.eval: (() => { const i = [...document.querySelectorAll('#outlet ui-todo-item')].find(x => x.text.startsWith('Write')); i.shadowRoot.querySelector('.step[data-v="100"]').click(); return i.checked && i.progress === 100; })()
